text: Onon ɓiɓɓe Isra'il ciftoree nde Min ndanndi on e boneeji yimɓe Fir'awna, ɓe pawii on kala lette, nde ɓe kirsi sukaaɓe mon worɓe haa mbaason heddaade, ɓe ngacca sukaaɓe mon rewɓe ngam ɓe ngollana ɓe, ɓe koyni on, ko jooma mon danndi on boneeji fir'awna e wallidiiɓe mum ngam humpitaade on, mbela joo njetton Mbo.
